test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 15 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A and B walk around a circular path of circumference 10 km. Both start from the same point in the same direction. If their speeds are 3 km/h and 2 km/h respectively, then after how much time will they be together again at the starting point?
solution:
**Given:**

Circumference of the circular path = 10 km

Speed of A = 3 km/h

Speed of B = 2 km/h

**Formula used:**

Time to meet at starting point = Circumference / Relative speed

**Calculation:**

Relative speed of A and B = Speed of A - Speed of B

Relative speed = 3 km/h - 2 km/h

Relative speed = 1 km/h

⇒ Time to meet at starting point = 10 km / 1 km/h

⇒ Time to meet at starting point = 10 h

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**
